artifact: A23 margin-quality certificate - negative-control evidence summary
purpose: Evidence and provenance for the sentence(s) stating that the margin-mass certificate is informative where it was validated and saturates (uninformative) on the generic-CLIP A23 control, with no advantage claimed from it.
certificate_definition: mass(eps) = mean(1[margin <= 2 eps]) with margin = s_i(y_i) - max_{c != y_i} s_i(c); mass is therefore the empirical CDF of the top-1 margin evaluated at 2 eps.

control_generic_clip.protocol: gap surgery, lambda translation along the gap direction
control_generic_clip.field_name_caveat: tools/_p1344_a23_certificate_control.py:123-125 fills the archive keys 'M(0.01)' and 'M(0.05)' from the same mass_0.05 column, so no M(0.01) value exists in this archive; both keys are NaN because mass_0.05 is identically 1.0 across all 14 configurations (zero variance).

adapted_marine_encoders.protocol: gap surgery on the 67-class marine subset; image-side translations, plus text-side at lambda=1

informative_reference_a1.definition: margin = s_i(y_i) - max_{c!=y_i} s_i(c); mass(eps) = mean(1[margin <= 2 eps])

datasets.note: Both control datasets carry 7 class directories on disk although the directory name 'fathomnet8' and the script docstring say 8 classes; the control archive stores no class count, so chance level is 1/7 = 14.29% under the loader's own class list (sorted subdirectories).

frozen_submitted_26_0663.verdict: absent from the submitted manuscript (26-0663, submitted 2026-09-21)

verdict.why: M(eps) is a CDF evaluated at 2 eps, so it saturates by construction once 2 eps exceeds the bulk of the margin distribution. In CLIP score units that bulk lies below ~0.02 in every archived domain: on the A1 ImageNet-5k reference the frozen model has margin median 0.0063 and reaches M(0.05) = 0.9998 / M(0.1) = 1.0 at 59.1% top-1, and the A23 adapted encoders (21.8% / 24.1% top-1) also have M(0.1) = 1.0. Within the control, M(0.05) and M(0.1) are identically 1.0 in all 14 configurations, which makes the archived correlation NaN and the threshold classifier degenerate to chance (BA 0.50); that is a real loss of usefulness at that operating point.
verdict.low_frozen_accuracy_caveat: The claim 'saturation happens because frozen accuracy is too low' is not supported by the archives: the 59.1%-accuracy ImageNet-5k reference saturates identically at eps >= 0.05, and the adapted marine encoders at 21.8-24.1% top-1 are not saturated at eps = 0.02. Frozen accuracy in the control is 21.57% (marine_optical) and 22.04% (acoustic_sonar) on 7 classes, i.e. above the 14.29% chance level, which is why the manuscript's current wording ('the frozen accuracy is too low for small margins to separate rows') should be replaced by the eps-grid explanation.
verdict.informative_operating_point: eps = 0.01 (never evaluated in the A23 control, whose grid starts at 0.02): A1 ImageNet-5k gives M(0.01) = 0.681 frozen and Pearson -0.9956 between M(0.01) and top-1 across 17 configurations, and 0.6772-0.7200 across the 10 prompt templates of the clip32 arm.
verdict.notes_paraphrase_check: The project notes' phrase 'frozen accuracy only 20-27%' is a paraphrase of the near-frozen band, not a single archived field: the archived lambda = 0 values are 21.5743% (marine_optical) and 22.0415% (acoustic_sonar); the full lambda grids span 19.8251-23.6152% and 2.5238-27.5379% respectively. The 'M approx 1' part of the notes is exact for eps >= 0.05 (constant 1.0 in all 14 configurations) and approximate at eps = 0.02 (0.9825-1.0).
verdict.holds_on: generic CLIP ViT-B/32 (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32) on fathomnet8 and NKSID; near-saturated and weakly correlated on BioCLIP-base and OceanCLIP over the 67-class marine subset; saturated at eps = 0.05 in every arm of every archive that records a margin mass (M(0.05) >= 0.976 in 108 arms, M(0.10) = 1.0 in 66 arms, across the control, both adapted encoders, the UATD and water-tank OOD probes, the A1 ImageNet-5k and marine-retrieval monitors); not saturated at eps = 0.01 on the A1 ImageNet-5k references.

conclusion: The margin-quality certificate M(eps) does not transfer as a portable scalar to the A23 control domains at the eps grid that was tested: on generic CLIP ViT-B/32 (fathomnet8 tree, 343 images, 7 classes; NKSID class directories, 1783 images, 7 classes) M(0.05) and M(0.1) equal 1.0 in all 14 surgery configurations, so the archived correlation with top-1 is undefined (NaN) and the fitted threshold degenerates to chance (BA 0.50 in both directions), while the adapted encoders (BioCLIP, OceanCLIP; 1608 images, 67 classes) show only weak within-family correlations (r = -0.346 / -0.564 at eps = 0.05) and a threshold fitted on one encoder fails on the other (BA 0.125-0.50). This saturation is an expected consequence of evaluating a margin CDF at a fixed coarse eps: in CLIP score units the margin bulk lies below ~0.02 in every archived domain, including the higher-accuracy ImageNet-5k reference (M(0.05) = 0.9998 at 59.1% top-1, M(0.1) = 1.0). It is therefore a failure of the tested operating point, not of the certificate's definition, and it must not be explained by low frozen accuracy alone, because the high-accuracy reference saturates identically. No advantage is claimed from the certificate anywhere in the A23 manuscript; the informative regime (eps = 0.01, where M(0.01) tracks top-1 at r = -0.996 on ImageNet-5k) has not been evaluated on the A23 domains.
provenance_gaps: The control archive stores no per-domain image or class counts; n = 343 (fathomnet8) is recovered from the accuracy fractions (74/343 = 21.5743...%) and n = 1783 (NKSID) from the loader's own glob over 7 class directories. The script docstring's '8 classes' is not what the loader collected (7 subdirectories in both trees).

The control's two domains are the raw data trees, not the manuscript's canonical protocols: fathomnet8 is 7 classes / 343 images (the paper's shipboard FathomNet subset is 6 concepts / 144 frames, and its marine reference domain is the 67-class rare-species subset with 1608 images), and the NKSID arm is 7 classes / 1783 imbalanced images (floats 951 of 1783) against the paper's balanced 8-class / 650-image sonar protocol. The NKSID tree holds 834 further loose img_*.jpg files at its root that the loader skipped.
The archive key 'M(0.01)' in a23_certificate_control.json is a duplicate of mass_0.05 (script lines 123-125); the control never measured M(0.01).
The control's threshold-transfer labels are a per-domain median split (script lines 128-133), so BA = 0.50 there reflects a degenerate constant predictor, not a validated transfer failure.
